name: Garden Social Beer Garden & Kitchen
description: A large craft beer garden and restaurant on Hempstead Turnpike with indoor and outdoor seating and many beers on tap. It books live bands and holds themed nights, including country line dancing.

dancing.notes: Garden Social has hosted country nights with line dancing lessons led by a local instructor and a DJ, and a local paper describes dancers of all ages out on the floor. On regular band nights it is mainly a place to eat and drink, so dancing then is less certain.

evidence.note: Local news story about country line dancing classes held at Garden Social, with dancers of all ages and skill levels.
